subject.title: fix(agents): clamp zero bash job TTLs

question: Should maintainers land this maintainer replacement or the open contributor PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102818 as the canonical zero-TTL fix?
rationale: Both open PRs implement the same central fix, this PR has a protected maintainer label, and deterministic cleanup should not close the protected branch or choose between equivalent landing candidates without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land this replacement
options.body: Use this maintainer-labeled branch as the canonical fix, preserving the co-author credit, then close the duplicate contributor PR with a link to the landed commit.

options.title: Land the contributor PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102818 as canonical instead, because it already has contributor proof and green CI for the same fix.

options.title: Preserve zero-as-default
options.body: If the previous env-zero fallback is considered a compatibility contract, pause or close both PRs and update docs/tests around the intended behavior.

recommendation.title: Land this replacement
recommendation.body: Use this maintainer-labeled branch as the canonical fix, preserving the co-author credit, then close the duplicate contributor PR with a link to the landed commit.
